channel.title: Signal
channel.description: Tech news matched to Patrick's interests, curated daily.

item.title: WoW Forever launch hub: live Nov 4, first hotfixes land
item.description: Live launch hub tracking WoW Forever since its Nov 4 debut: the first Nov 5 hotfixes fixing NPC spawns, vendors and Plainsrunning stacking, plus launch guides and the Dec 9 raid roadmap.

item.title: The Agent Harness, Explained: what Microsoft shipped and how to build on it in Python
item.description: A hands-on walkthrough of Microsoft Agent Framework's stable Python/.NET harness — planning, memory, approvals, and telemetry in one call — with a working night-shift ops agent built on it and runnable code.

item.title: Unsloth Shrinks Qwen3.8-Flash-Next to 74.5 GB for Local Coding Agents
item.description: Unsloth's Dynamic V3.1 GGUF quants bring the 125B MoE Qwen3.8-Flash-Next down to 74.5 GB, fitting local coding-agent runs on high-memory workstations.

item.title: WoW Forever UK launch time: 11pm on November 4
item.description: Blizzard's Classic+ goes live worldwide at a single moment, 3pm Pacific, which is 11pm UK time on November 4, included with a standard WoW subscription.

item.title: Dataiku Headless brings governed data work into coding agents
item.description: Dataiku Headless lets developers build and modify governed data pipelines, models and dashboards from the coding agent they already use, with its Cobuild agent doing the Dataiku-side work behind the scenes.

item.title: Codein v2.2.7 Turns Android Into a More Powerful Local AI Coding Workspace
item.description: Codein v2.2.7 adds a local Termux bridge, model routing, and browser tools to its Android AI coding app, letting an agent run approved commands on-device without root.

item.title: Qwen3.6-35b-a3b on 5060ti using Ollama for Hermes
item.description: A 5060 Ti owner works through getting Qwen3.6-35B-A3B to 120K context in Ollama: flash attention plus a q8_0 KV cache, with llama-swap as the VRAM-friendly alternative.

item.title: TwIL-8B: 8.8B Model Claims 93% of Frontier Coding Score
item.description: webAI's open-weight 8.8B reasoning model, post-trained from IBM Granite 4.2, claims near-frontier math and coding scores with a 5 GB Q4_K_M GGUF, though the numbers are the vendor's own and the license is non-commercial.

item.title: With World of Warcraft: Forever, Blizzard Had To Reconnect With What Made WoW Great In The First Place
item.description: On the eve of the November 4 launch, lead encounter designer Michael Nuthals describes unlearning modern WoW habits to recapture Classic dungeon and raid design, with horizontal progression keeping the cap at 60.

item.title: IndiaAI Mission launches EKA-1 and Dhir offline models
item.description: Government-backed Indian launch of a 26.3B sparse hybrid model plus 2B and 5B compact models aimed at offline, on-device and on-premise use across Indian languages.

item.title: Three new Savage Worlds releases for Foundry VTT
item.description: Pinnacle ships three new Foundry VTT releases — two Deadlands: The Weird West adventures and a Pathfinder for Savage Worlds asset pack — plus a limited-time Hollerween bundle through November 15.

item.title: WoW Forever Explained: What It Is, Dates, What Is New
item.description: A launch-day explainer for WoW Forever: global launch November 4 at 3 PM PST, level cap staying at 60, first raids December 9, and the 2027 roadmap.

item.title: WoW: Forever launches November 4: the Classic+ game at a glance
item.description: BlizzardWatch's launch rundown of WoW: Forever, refreshed ahead of the November 4 debut, covering the new zones, the faction-choosing Skyborne race, and the account-wide Legacy reward system.

item.title: BuddhiAI CLI v1.0.0: agent harness for Google Antigravity
item.description: Version 1.0 of a spec-driven agent harness for Google Antigravity, pairing a topology-aware code-graph MCP server with token-budget-aware file reading to fight context degradation in large codebases.

item.title: DeepSeek releases autonomous coding agent prototype to rival Claude Code
item.description: DeepSeek’s Harness team open-sourced dsh-superagent, a research prototype that monitors a GitHub repo, picks up authorized coding tasks through a router-worker design, and returns results with limited human supervision.

item.title: DeepSeek Open-Sourced Its Autonomous Coding Agent — and Says Coding Agents Wrote Most of the Code
item.description: DeepSeek's MIT-licensed super-agent prototype watches a repo's GitHub activity, takes on authorized work items, and reports back with pull requests — notable partly because coding agents wrote much of the tool itself.

item.title: World of Warcraft: Forever Arrives November 4: From a 1994 Strategy Game to an Online World Built to Last
item.description: Launch-eve rundown of WoW: Forever ahead of its November 4 worldwide debut, tracing the game from its 1994 strategy roots to a new permanent Classic-era world with fresh zones, dungeons, and raids.

item.title: DeepSeek releases a free, experimental AI coding agent
item.description: DeepSeek's MIT-licensed dsh-superagent prototype takes coding requests through GitHub and works them in isolated sessions, but the lab itself calls it unaudited research code rather than a production-ready product.

item.title: DeepSeek Harness Creator Mode: Build Plugins by Chat
item.description: DeepSeek's open-source Harness gains a Creator Mode that lets users add plugins, features, and custom UI to the agent by describing them in conversation rather than writing the code by hand.

item.title: axteam/gemma-4-31B-GGUF
item.description: Community GGUF builds of Google's new Gemma 4 31B, with Q4_K_M and Q8_0 files and perplexity measured on a B200 on November 2.

item.title: Run AI Models Locally Without Extra VRAM: Settings Guide
item.description: Offloading inactive MoE experts to system RAM via a llama.cpp flag reportedly lifts a Qwen MoE model from 4 to 33 tokens per second on an 8GB-VRAM laptop.

item.title: DeepSeek's open-source Super-agent watches GitHub repos and steps in with fixes
item.description: DeepSeek's Harness team released an MIT-licensed Super-agent prototype that monitors a team's GitHub repo and takes on coding work unprompted, passing 4,000 stars within a day of release.

item.title: DeepSeek's Super-Agent: a proactive coding agent that watches GitHub and files PRs unprompted
item.description: DeepSeek published an MIT-licensed research prototype of a proactive coding agent: a Router watches permitted GitHub and Feishu activity while isolated Worker sessions do the coding, explicitly labelled not production-ready.

item.title: DeepSeek open-sources router-worker coding-agent prototype
item.description: DeepSeek's MIT-licensed super-agent prototype pairs a resident router with parallel worker sessions that take on permitted GitHub work and answer back with pull requests.

item.title: DeepSeek's dsh-superagent: 3,700 stars in its first day
item.description: DeepSeek's proactive coding-agent prototype, which watches a repo and hands approved work to isolated worker sessions, drew roughly 3,700 GitHub stars within 24 hours of its October 31 release.

item.title: MiniCPM-OCR: small open-weight document-parsing models for edge deployment
item.description: ModelBest and OpenBMB open-sourced two compact document-parsing models, a 1.3B OCR model and a 2B output-scoring companion, aimed at self-hosted edge and on-premises use with llama.cpp, vLLM, SGLang and Ollama support.

item.title: DeepSeek open-sources the architecture behind its super-agent prototype
item.description: DeepSeek published a research prototype of a proactive coding agent that watches repo events and hands off accepted work, built on its plugin-based Harness runtime and flagged as experimental rather than production-ready.

item.title: DeepSeek Open-Sources dsh-superagent, a Router-Worker Coding Agent
item.description: A technical rundown of DeepSeek's MIT-licensed super-agent bundle for Harness, covering its router-worker design, runtime requirements, and how it compares with Copilot, Claude Code, and Codex.

item.title: DeepSeek open-sources the architecture behind its super-agent prototype
item.description: DeepSeek's Harness team published an MIT-licensed research prototype of a proactive coding agent that listens to a single GitHub repo, routes requests to isolated worker sessions, and returns results as pull requests.

item.title: DeepSeek unveils open-source super-agent coding tool to rival Claude Code
item.description: DeepSeek's Harness team published a proactive coding-agent prototype that watches team chats and repo activity for coding problems and proposes fixes unprompted, rather than waiting for a prompt.

item.title: DeepSeek Open-Sourced Its Agent Stack: What It Means
item.description: DeepSeek's MIT-licensed Harness runtime lets developers self-host the layer between a model and its tools, with composable plugins for sessions, sandboxes, and agent loops — still an unaudited developer preview, not production-ready software.

item.title: DeepSeek drops a free coding agent that takes requests from GitHub
item.description: DeepSeek's MIT-licensed dsh-superagent prototype watches a single GitHub repo, takes authorized requests, and answers with proposed code changes or pull requests, with a human-review panel in the loop.

item.title: Speed up local AI on Windows with llama.cpp: MoE offloading and speculative decoding
item.description: Two practical llama.cpp knobs for modest Windows PCs: park MoE expert weights in system RAM with --n-cpu-moe, and pair a small draft model for speculative decoding to lift generation speed.

item.title: DeepSeek's open-source Super-agent prototype takes GitHub requests
item.description: DeepSeek's Harness team published an MIT-licensed prototype that watches repo conversations, picks up coding issues unprompted, and returns fixes as pull requests through a Router-and-Worker design.

item.title: DeepSeek Super-agent prototype: one repo, many parallel coding jobs
item.description: A second look at DeepSeek's Oct 31 prototype: a persistent Router turns authorized GitHub requests into separate Worker sessions, with early simulated tests claiming faster completion than single-session setups.

item.title: DeepSeek's super-agent prototype: a router plus workers that take GitHub requests
item.description: DeepSeek's MIT-licensed dsh-superagent prototype splits coding work into a persistent router that triages GitHub or Feishu requests and isolated worker sessions that do the work and return pull requests, trading human attention for parallel agent sessions.

item.title: DeepSeek's Super-agent: a proactive coding agent that watches your repo
item.description: DeepSeek's Harness team published an MIT-licensed prototype that listens to a GitHub repo and dispatches worker sessions to handle approved requests, router-style.

item.title: DeepSeek's super-agent prototype cuts p95 task time in simulated tests
item.description: In DeepSeek's simulated benchmarks, the router-worker prototype cut 95th-percentile task completion from 29.5 minutes to 15.7 minutes, with rule-based gating over proactive edits.

item.title: DeepSeek releases a coding-agent prototype on its open-source Harness
item.description: DeepSeek's MIT-licensed super-agent prototype routes permitted GitHub requests through a persistent router to isolated worker sessions that return pull requests, though it remains unaudited research code rather than a production tool.

item.title: LFM3-1.7B on-device: the 256K KV-cache math and which GGUF to ship
item.description: Works out what Liquid AI's new 1.7B tri-hybrid model actually costs on device: KV-cache memory at 256K context, which of its GGUF files (Q4_K_M vs the QAD Q4_0 build) to pick, and the safety test to run first.
